description: Two independent constant voltage sources, each switched on and off by hand

params.text: Sets the voltage that half puts out while it is on, 0V to 10V
One press turns that half on and the next turns it off; the lamp is lit while it is on, and the output is held at 0V while it is off

outputs.text: The voltage set for that half while it is switched on, and 0V while it is off

notes: Each half holds its output at 0V until its ON button has been pressed; the button is a latch, one press on and the next press off.
